horizons_years_meta.rationale: Current Thesis / Primary Optimization / Persistence horizons.

initial_growth.rationale: Gateway/government revenue is lumpy and grew from a tiny base; center discounts extraordinary percentage growth while allowing contract milestones and backlog conversion.

long_run_growth_y8.rationale: Existing gateway/government revenue remains ancillary to SpaceMobile and should not dominate long-run value.

growth_half_life_years_meta.rationale: Pre-service gateway/government recognition is milestone-driven and mean-reverts quickly.

latent_loading_meta.rationale: Government/contract cycles are shared, but recognition is highly idiosyncratic.

initial_annual_revenue.rationale: First full service-year revenue assumption after commercial onset; supported qualitatively by 1.30B contracted backlog and >60 MNO relationships but not equated to backlog or company guidance.

post_service_growth.rationale: Early service ramp can be very steep from a low base, but is constrained by satellite coverage, MNO activation and regulation.

long_run_growth_y8.rationale: Long-run direct-to-device service growth after the initial constellation ramp.

growth_half_life_years_meta.rationale: Service growth decays across several constellation and MNO activation cycles.

reference_value.rationale: Reduced-form milestone-conditioned reference value for SpaceMobile service economics, deliberately independent of current ASTS market price.

residual_on_failure_meta.rationale: Gateway/government assets, spectrum/IP and remaining constellation assets retain some value if commercial SpaceMobile fails, but most current optionality is service-dependent.

probability_meta.rationale: 13 spacecraft are in orbit, six launched within 50 days and 30 more were in production; launch/manufacturing execution remains material.

timing.rationale: Quarters from 2026-09-25 to demonstrate sustained launch/manufacturing cadence; distribution, not a company date.

value_uplift_meta.rationale: Cadence reduces deployment risk but does not itself create recurring service revenue.

retry_probability_meta.rationale: Launch/manufacturing setbacks can be retried after remediation.

probability_meta.rationale: FCC has authorized the 248-satellite planned network, but operating/spectrum approvals remain market-by-market internationally.

timing.rationale: Quarters to sufficient multi-market operating approvals for initial commercial launch; FCC U.S. network authorization is already a verified fact.

value_uplift_meta.rationale: Multi-market readiness reduces spectrum/regulatory bottleneck risk.

retry_probability_meta.rationale: Approval delay is more likely to shift timing than permanently destroy all service value.

probability_meta.rationale: Conditional on launch cadence and regulatory readiness, signed MNO agreements/backlog support a majority onset prior; no SpaceMobile Service revenue existed at Q2.

timing.rationale: Quarters after prerequisites to initial recurring SpaceMobile Service revenue; not a hard company date.

value_uplift_meta.rationale: First recurring service revenue validates the core business model.

retry_probability_meta.rationale: Commercial onset can be delayed by integration/coverage issues without immediate terminal failure.

probability_meta.rationale: Company states approximately 45–60 BB satellites can enable continuous coverage in key markets; reaching that deployed, functioning fleet remains a material execution hurdle.

timing.rationale: Quarters after service onset to continuous key-market coverage; grounded in 45–60 satellite requirement but not a company timing commitment.

value_uplift_meta.rationale: Continuous coverage supports materially broader usage and service economics.

net_cash_0_meta.formula: Legacy C-engine liquidity-reserve field uses >3.7B pro-forma cash/cash equivalents/restricted cash after July 2026 financing as burn reserve; it is NOT GAAP net cash after debt.

pre_service_burn_quarterly.rationale: H1 OCF + PP&E cash use was 1.004B, ~0.502B/quarter; range includes launch/satellite procurement volatility.

dilution_penalty_meta.rationale: Latest July 2026 financing reported <2% effective dilution, but future funding across a pre-service capital program can be more dilutive; 25% is a reduced-form downside penalty, not a forecast.

core_margin.rationale: Gateway/government activities are small and lumpy; mature core economics are uncertain and not treated as the primary value engine.

current_margin_at_onset_meta.rationale: Initial service onset is assumed loss-making while coverage/utilization ramp.

terminal_margin_Y5.rationale: Scaled operator-partner revenue-sharing can produce strong cash margins, with wide tails for network cost, partner economics and capacity utilization.

half_life_years_meta.rationale: Service margin converges over multiple coverage/utilization cycles.

fcf_maturity_margin_meta.rationale: Below 8% FCF margin, a revenue bridge is more informative than a mature FCF multiple.

multiple_fcf.rationale: Mature satellite-connectivity FCF multiple after service validation, with broad technical/regulatory/competitive tails.

multiple_revenue_bridge.rationale: Primary reference revenue bridge before FCF maturity. Center 5.5x is parity-consistent with 22% terminal service margin ×25x FCF, limiting artificial basis cliffs.

factor_correlations_meta.rationale: Successful deployment/activation supports growth and margins, while technical and regulatory outcomes preserve high idiosyncratic risk.

default_loading_meta.rationale: Milestone-driven company-specific launch/manufacturing/regulatory execution dominates common market factors.

annualized_sigma_meta.rationale: Pre-service milestone equity has very high path volatility; used only in drawdown layer.

valuation_mean_reversion_half_life_years.rationale: Milestone repricing can persist until the next launch/regulatory/coverage resolution.

implied_revenue_cagr_5y_meta.formula: Local deterministic preflight of reverse_valuation 1.2.0 equation; replace run_ref with authoritative sidecar run.

driver_parameter_mapping.note: Secondary industrial-cycle channel. SPACE_SYSTEMS_EXECUTION critical failure has no canonical taxonomy root; it remains intrinsic milestone risk and a recalibration trigger rather than a fabricated mapping.

scenario_persistence_override.innovation_formula: eta_d,t = standardize(sum(lambda_d,r * u_r,t) + w_d * epsilon_d,t), with u_r,t root innovations after the current phase root-correlation state and epsilon_d,t the same driver idiosyncratic innovation used by BASE
scenario_persistence_override.initialization: when override begins, y_d,t-1 equals the last emitted standardized driver shock; do not initialize to zero
scenario_persistence_override.ramp_rule: numeric-to-numeric rho is linearly interpolated by phase weight; null is bypass and is not interpreted as rho=0
scenario_persistence_override.validation_rule: on a constant-rho plateau after warm-up, Var(y) must remain approximately 1 and empirical lag-1 correlation must approximate rho; insufficient plateau length is diagnostic, not failure

driver_generation.explicit_idiosyncratic_rule: These taxonomy drivers intentionally have no root mapping in v1.1. They retain independent standardized driver innovations; scenario mean/volatility overrides may still apply if a scenario explicitly names them. No root covariance is implied until a future normative reissue adds a mapping.

scenario.description: Gray-zone Taiwan quarantine led by PRC coast-guard/law-enforcement pressure: inspections, partial port/route restrictions, shipping/insurance and capital-market friction without armed conflict; followed by partial normalization or a persistent frozen gray-zone regime.

probability_meta.rationale: Owner judgment 2026-09-27 (DR-2026-09-25-02, variant V1): 0.175 = midpoint of owner estimate 15-20% by end-2028 for a coast-guard quarantine / partial blockade without armed conflict; mutually exclusive with TAIWAN_SEIZURE (0.10) and CHIP_COLD_WAR (0.07), BASE residual 0.655. Carried into v1.1 by the integrator (package predates the decision). Review rule: TQ-F01..F08 fact catalog; each scenario reissue; at least quarterly.

excludes.reason: Full effective blockade is classified as TAIWAN_SEIZURE under the current conservative owner mapping.
Any verified kinetic conflict exits the non-kinetic quarantine member and requires TAIWAN_SEIZURE classification/review.
Prior leading-edge parity is not modeled jointly with quarantine in the current mutually exclusive set.

base_when.narrative: BASE remains when patrols, exercises or limited restrictions do not reach the persistent inspection/partial-blockade threshold.

conditions.condition: event may be confirmed while quarantine criteria remain unconfirmed
event may be confirmed and remains BASE-compatible

scope.narrative: Shared restrictions precursor -> persistent gray-zone inspections/partial blockade without combat -> partial normalization or frozen gray-zone new normal.

meta.rationale: Scenario is conditioned on onset of material restrictions at t0.
Material access friction without assuming full physical outage.
Cross-strait/export friction weakens China-linked revenue.
Near-term deployment caution offsets some substitution demand.
Packaging/memory logistics tighten.
Advanced packaging access becomes less reliable.
Near-term fab/equipment activity pauses before reconstruction response.
Risk-off financing shock.
Defense demand rises modestly.
Cross-strait supply and China access become more coupled.
AI capex becomes more dependent on semiconductor supply health.

Shared entry state with TAIWAN_SEIZURE for comparability: material restrictions/friction are present at t0, but this scenario is conditioned on escalation to gray-zone quarantine rather than armed conflict.

phases.name: Gray-zone coast-guard quarantine / partial route and port restriction

meta.rationale: Quarantine onset after the common restrictions phase is uncertain; q1/q2/q4 represents a one-to-four-quarter escalation window without armed conflict.
Sustained inspections, routing frictions and partial port restrictions impair Taiwan-linked supply, but less than a full blockade/conflict.
Export-control escalation and cross-strait commercial friction reduce China-linked addressability without assuming full sanctions separation.
Deployment caution and delayed hardware availability temporarily outweigh replacement demand; shock is milder than blockade/conflict.
Shipping and insurance friction delays HBM delivery without assuming physical production loss.
Packaging logistics and Taiwan concentration create persistent delay/cost friction, milder than armed-conflict disruption.
Near-term installation/shipment uncertainty and Taiwan project delays dominate before localization response.
Persistent geopolitical risk premium, Taiwan capital outflow and shipping-risk repricing create material risk-off conditions.
Deterrence, munitions replenishment and regional readiness spending rise, but without war-economy intensity.
Quarantine couples Taiwan supply friction with China market/export access more strongly than BASE, but below conflict calibration.
AI buildout becomes more dependent on semiconductor logistics and supply health.
Risk premia and compute deployment become more coupled under persistent gray-zone pressure.
Gray-zone quarantine is explicitly non-kinetic: coast-guard/law-enforcement pressure, inspections and partial route/port restrictions without armed hostilities.

phases.name: Partial normalization or persistent gray-zone new normal

meta.rationale: Acute quarantine pressure is assumed to begin easing or freezing into a lower-intensity regime four to twelve quarters after quarantine onset; this is uncertainty, not a forecast.
Most traffic normalizes, but insurance, rerouting and contingency inventory keep Taiwan-linked supply below BASE.
Export-control and market-access friction remains part of the post-quarantine new normal.
Acute deployment drag fades; no separate structural demand boom is assumed absent conflict/reconstruction.
HBM logistics mostly recover but retain a modest risk premium and inventory friction.
Packaging access mostly normalizes but contingency logistics remain costlier than BASE.
After acute delays, diversification and contingency capacity support a modest WFE/localization response.
Acute risk-off fades, but Taiwan/geopolitical risk premium remains above BASE.
Deterrence and readiness spending remain structurally elevated after the acute quarantine phase.
Supply and market-access risks remain somewhat coupled in the frozen gray-zone regime.
Compute buildout remains more supply-sensitive than BASE after firms adopt contingency sourcing.
Residual risk premium keeps funding and AI deployment slightly more coupled than BASE.

This is a single target state spanning partial normalization through a persistent frozen gray zone; Scenario Engine v1.0 has no internal branch probabilities. Escalation to armed seizure belongs to the mutually exclusive TAIWAN_SEIZURE scenario.

exit_criteria.condition: scenario horizon reached; gray-zone state remains until end of modeled horizon

fact_catalog.signal: Number/location of PRC China Coast Guard or other official vessels around Taiwan, especially east of the island, and any transition from patrol to inspection/boarding of commercial traffic.
preferred_sources: Taiwan Ministry of National Defense daily PLA/official-ship activity
PRC China Coast Guard / Maritime Safety Administration notices
fact_catalog.note: Patrol count alone is not quarantine. Phase evidence requires inspection/boarding, compulsory routing, port/route restriction or equivalent coercive law-enforcement action.

fact_catalog.signal: Mobilization, requisition or concentrated exercise use of civilian roll-on/roll-off ferries or other dual-use sealift near the Taiwan theater.
fact_catalog.note: Track vessel count, dates and operating area; exercise appearance is a signal, not proof of an imminent kinetic operation.

fact_catalog.signal: Status of the delayed U.S. Taiwan arms package reported at about USD 14B after the U.S.–China summit: approval, notification, modification, cancellation or continued hold.
preferred_sources: U.S. Department of State / Congress notifications
fact_catalog.note: Current baseline reported by Reuters in September 2026 is that a roughly USD 14B package remained delayed; Dozor should verify only official disposition changes.

fact_catalog.signal: Explicit production/output cadence, contracted quantities or delivery acceleration for Patriot interceptors and LRASM / related anti-ship missiles relevant to Taiwan/regional deterrence.
preferred_sources: U.S. Department of Defense / service budget and contract notices
fact_catalog.note: Use only explicitly disclosed quantities/cadence. If a production rate is not disclosed, record not_disclosed rather than estimating.

fact_catalog.signal: War-risk / additional-premium insurance rates, exclusions or availability changes for commercial shipping serving Taiwan or transiting the Taiwan Strait.
fact_catalog.note: Track quoted premium change with vessel class/route/date where available; generic geopolitical commentary is insufficient.

fact_catalog.signal: TSMC or key Taiwan semiconductor suppliers disclose shipment delays, customer-delivery disruption, logistics rerouting, inventory build or production interruption attributable to cross-strait restrictions.
fact_catalog.note: Differentiate logistics delay from fab-production outage; the latter would imply calibration toward TAIWAN_SEIZURE severity.

fact_catalog.signal: Daily PLA aircraft, PLAN ships and PRC official-ship counts around Taiwan, including eastern ADIZ / median-line activity and persistent coast-guard presence.
preferred_sources: Taiwan Ministry of National Defense daily PLA activities
fact_catalog.note: ADIZ or ship activity is a pressure indicator only; it does not by itself satisfy the quarantine phase.

fact_catalog.signal: Port throughput, vessel waiting times, cancellations or compulsory rerouting at Taiwan's principal commercial ports/routes.
preferred_sources: Taiwan Ministry of Transportation and Communications
fact_catalog.note: Preferred machine-checkable metrics are vessel calls, throughput, waiting time and formally closed/restricted routes.

notes: TAIWAN_QUARANTINE is mutually exclusive with TAIWAN_SEIZURE: this calibration never escalates into armed conflict.
NORMALIZATION_OR_FROZEN is a single conditional target state because Scenario Engine v1.0 has no branching; it is not a probability-weighted internal mixture.

BASE contains the observed 2026 strategic technology/defense race through company-state centers and zero-centered Joint shocks around the current regime; scenario overrides are deviations from that regime.
CHIP_COLD_WAR/RACE_TO_PARITY should be read as acceleration of the existing race toward parity, not as the initial existence of the race.
Scenario does not prescribe portfolio action.
